activity_definition: mean gene-wise z-score per cell; one-sided Wilcoxon target-state cells > all other cells; BH within method x time; adjusted P <= 0.05
GO_definition: at least one GO term with within-module BH-adjusted P <= 0.05
marker_definition: COSG top-50 for corresponding time; one-sided hypergeometric test; BH across modules within method x time; adjusted P <= 0.05
marker_fraction_definition: corresponding-time COSG marker genes contained in evaluable modules / sum of evaluable module sizes across module-time instances
